environment.description: Node.js Express API gateway deployed on a Kubernetes cluster with a standard nginx ingress controller. The service is exposed via a public LoadBalancer type Service on port 443. No header stripping or filtering is configured on the ingress. The downstream gRPC user-service trusts x-auth-user and x-auth-role metadata fields for authorization decisions (service mesh mTLS authenticates the API gateway pod, so the user-service trusts all metadata from it). Any internet client can reach the Express service directly.

config.grpc_service_auth: mTLS between pods (trusts metadata from api-gateway)
